options.content:
## syfo-budstikka Dashboard

**Pipeline flow:** Kafka topic -> Inbox (ingest) -> Decision (process) -> Delivery (downstream handoff)

| Row | What it shows | How to read it |
|-----|---------------|----------------|
| **Domain Pipeline** | Recorded processing signals and downstream handoffs | Counters show operational trends, not authoritative database state or a one-to-one accounting. A formidling can create zero or several deliveries. DROPPED currently means an expected death-gate outcome, not deduplication. |
| **Worker Health** | Background worker runs, failures and iteration duration | Runs are a heartbeat. Failure signals should normally be zero. Rising duration can indicate slow work. |
| **Kafka Topic Health** | Budstikka consumer lag and consumed records | Increasing lag means the consumer is falling behind. Lag alone does not prove whether internal inbox or delivery work is progressing. |
| **Logs** | Error volume and a bounded, safe error projection | Raw messages, exceptions and references are intentionally omitted from the dashboard. |
| **Event Trace** | Safe lifecycle stages for one Event ID | Shows ingest, decision and downstream handoff stages. Downstream accepted does not prove end-user delivery. |

**No data is not green:** ratio panels remain No observations when no terminal signals were recorded.

**Units:** Rates are events/sec. Duration is seconds. Lag is records.

spec.expr: 100 * (sum(increase(inbox_message_processed_total{app="syfo-budstikka", namespace="team-esyfo", k8s_cluster_name="$environment"}[$__range])) + (sum(increase(inbox_message_dropped_total{app="syfo-budstikka", namespace="team-esyfo", k8s_cluster_name="$environment"}[$__range])) or on() vector(0))) / ((sum(increase(inbox_message_processed_total{app="syfo-budstikka", namespace="team-esyfo", k8s_cluster_name="$environment"}[$__range])) + (sum(increase(inbox_message_dropped_total{app="syfo-budstikka", namespace="team-esyfo", k8s_cluster_name="$environment"}[$__range])) or on() vector(0)) + sum(increase(inbox_message_failed_total{app="syfo-budstikka", namespace="team-esyfo", k8s_cluster_name="$environment"}[$__range]))) > 0)

spec.description: Share of recorded terminal inbox signals that were processed or expectedly dropped instead of failed. WAIT, retries and repository poison transitions are not represented. Missing observations remain No observations.
spec.title: Recorded Inbox Outcomes without Failure %

spec.expr: sum by (worker) (rate(worker_duration_seconds_sum{app="syfo-budstikka", namespace="team-esyfo", k8s_cluster_name="$environment"}[5m])) / sum by (worker) (rate(worker_duration_seconds_count{app="syfo-budstikka", namespace="team-esyfo", k8s_cluster_name="$environment"}[5m]))

spec.description: Worker iteration duration. avg = rate(sum)/rate(count), aggregates correctly across pods and shows the duration trend. max = worst iteration in the window (per worker, across pods). A rising avg or spiking max indicates slow or stuck iterations. No percentiles: worker tail-latency is not actionable today, and client-side percentiles cannot be aggregated across pods.
spec.title: Worker Duration (avg / max)

spec.description: Maximum lag per partition for Budstikka's consumer clients. Max avoids double-counting stale pod or rebalance series.
spec.title: Consumer Lag (team-esyfo.budstikka.v1)

spec.description: Total records consumed per second by Budstikka's consumer clients. The exported metric has no partition label.
spec.title: Records Consumed / sec (Budstikka Consumer)
